_comment: Real-world payload Evolution API sends to your n8n webhook on event=messages.upsert. Use this to test the workflow without setting up WhatsApp end-to-end. Send via curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/evolution-incoming -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @evolution_messages_upsert.json
